policy: Rules were fixed before the V3.9.10 rerun. Corpus abundance is evidence maturity only and cannot directly increase a material score.
basedOn: V3.9.8 abundance-bias audit plus FAIR-MOFs v1 synthesis-condition evidence

algorithm.name: Host-Guest Complementary Pathway Screening Algorithm
algorithm.mlPolicy: No model training or inference is used in this rerun. Source fields and curated tables are aggregated by fixed rules.

abundanceBiasCorrection.invarianceRequirement: Duplicating otherwise identical CoRE or FAIR-MOFs rows must not improve the material point score.

dataReality.stability: CoRE MOF 2024 CSD-modified supplies record-level water-stability probability, solvent-stability probability, and thermal-stability temperature. Family medians are shrunk toward global priors; record count is not a benefit term.
dataReality.synthesizability: FAIR-MOFs has successful-synthesis condition records but no harmonized failure set or yield. The factor is therefore a synthesis-condition accessibility proxy, not a synthesis-success probability.
dataReality.fairMofsIdentity: Exact or base CSD Refcode establishes structure-level association. Shared DOI is article-level association only and never establishes structure identity.
dataReality.economics: Economics remains a transparent screening-level precursor/LCC proxy and is not a supplier quotation or full process cost model.

normalization.default: fixed physical bounds or empirical-Bayes shrinkage; cross-family min-max only where explicitly retained

hgcpsFormula: finalHGCPS = product(max(factor, 0.001) ^ routeWeight); route weights sum to 1

stability.prior: global record-level median for the same descriptor
stability.formula: component = reliability * familyMedian + (1 - reliability) * globalMedian; reliability = n / (n + 20); stabilityProxy = 0.55*water + 0.30*solvent + 0.15*thermal
stability.abundanceBoundary: n affects shrinkage and confidence only; no family-frequency term is present.

synthesizability.duplicateRule: one effective observation per normalized DOI plus condition fingerprint
synthesizability.recordFormula: mean(clamp((523.15 - T)/(523.15 - 298.15)), clamp(1 - ln(max(time,1))/ln(168))) using available components
synthesizability.missingPolicy: global neutral empirical prior with zero direct-evidence confidence
synthesizability.transferPolicy: UiO-type and MOF-808-like may use the Zr-family point estimate only when direct evidence is absent; confidence is multiplied by 0.45 and the transfer is visibly labeled.
synthesizability.abundanceBoundary: Raw record frequency and log-frequency are excluded from the point score. n controls shrinkage and confidence only.
synthesizability.outcomeBoundary: This is not synthesis-success probability because FAIR-MOFs does not provide a harmonized failure set or yield.

poreEnvironmentScore.descriptor: surface area, pore volume, and void fraction structural support
poreEnvironmentScore.aggregate: family median for each numeric field; mean of normalized field medians

co2EnrichmentSupport.descriptor: CO2 adsorption support combined with ligand chemistry

ligandPathwaySupport.aggregate: fixed descriptor formula from spec v2
ligandPathwaySupport.normalization: descriptor bounds and preregistered tier values

stabilityProxy.aggregate: empirical-Bayes-shrunk family medians under fixed component weights
stabilityProxy.normalization: native 0-1 probabilities plus fixed 150-450 C thermal bounds; no cross-family frequency normalization

postModificationFeasibility.aggregate: curated fallback; no imported direct descriptor

guestHostingFeasibility.aggregate: curated fallback; no imported direct descriptor

synthesizabilityScore.normalization: fixed temperature/log-time bounds; no cross-family frequency normalization
synthesizabilityScore.derivationLevel: data-derived FAIR-MOFs condition proxy or explicitly transferred proxy

guestFactorMappings.dataDerivedPolicy: Only derive a guest factor from reaction/literature/gold records when the guest metal appears as a primary metalNode with nRecords >= threshold. Otherwise use the existing literature prior and label fallback.
guestFactorMappings.performanceAggregate: mean of normalized yield, selectivity, and conversion across eligible records
guestFactorMappings.fallbackReason: No dedicated dopant or guest-metal dataset field is present in the imported data.

hostGuestComplementarityScore.source: rule-derived from host stability, host pathway support, and guest activity

synthesizabilityScore.derivationLevel: data-derived condition proxy; confidence reported separately

economicScore.source: curated metal precursor price table + LCC proxy
economicScore.aggregate: estimatedCost = 0.65 * hostMetalUSDkg + 0.20 * guestMetalUSDkg + 0.10 * ligandCostTierUSDkg + 0.05 * synthesisEnergyIndexUSDkg; economicScore = inverse min-max estimatedCost across routes
economicScore.boundary: Screening inputs are not supplier quotations or measured process costs.

economics.boundary: Curated screening inputs support transparent relative screening only; they are not supplier quotations or a full process LCC.
